name: Sandy's Spotless Cleaning
address_note: ZIP 33029 straddles the Pembroke Pines / Hollywood / Miramar USPS boundary in Broward County; third-party directories (MapQuest, Yelp) list the same exact address under 'Hollywood, FL 33029'. The task brief confirmed the business as Pembroke Pines, FL, so that is used throughout the site and this record.
email_research: Deep search performed: Google, Google Business Profile aggregators (hireanypro.com, a 'gobookit.in' directory that returned HTTP 503/TLS errors on every attempt), MapQuest listing (full JSON-LD page data extracted), Yelp listing (blocked by anti-bot, but indexed via Google/Bing snippets and via MapQuest's embedded data), Thumbtack, Facebook, Instagram, Nextdoor. No public email found anywhere. Real contact channel is phone/SMS.
own_site_check_result: No own website found in 20+ web searches across Google, Bing-style queries, and niche cleaning directories for 'Sandy's Spotless Cleaning' + Pembroke Pines/Hollywood/954-608-0904/752 NW 208th Ter/33029. The only web presence found: (1) an unclaimed Yelp listing (yelp.com/biz/sandys-spotless-cleaning-hollywood), (2) a MapQuest auto-generated business page built from the same Yelp/data-provider feed, (3) a generic lead-gen directory page on hireanypro.com, (4) a 503-erroring directory gobookit.in. No Instagram, no Facebook page, no booking platform (Booksy/Thumbtack profile/GlossGenius) found. Confirmed: no own website.
review_count_research_note: Rating/review count as given in the task brief (5.0 / 26, verified against the business's own Google Business Profile). Third-party directory scrapes found during research (hireanypro.com: 5.0 from 21 reviews; gobookit.in snippet via search: 5.0 from 22 reviews) are older/stale crawls of the same growing GBP and corroborate a consistently perfect 5.0 rating, not a discrepancy.

hours.source: Confirmed directly from structured data (schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD and the rendered hours panel) embedded in MapQuest's page for this exact business listing (mapquest.com/us/florida/sandys-spotless-cleaning-778745857), which mirrors the business's own Google/Yelp-sourced hours. openingHoursSpecification: Mon-Fri 08:30-16:30, Sat/Sun closed.

review_samples_note: No verbatim Google review text with reviewer names could be retrieved. Google Maps reviews are JavaScript-rendered and not accessible through available fetch tools; no search engine or cached page surfaced the actual review text for this business (only aggregate rating/count were found, repeatedly, via GBP-derived directory snippets). Per the 'never invent' rule, no fabricated testimonials or reviewer names were added to the site. The Reviews section instead shows the real 5.0/26 aggregate with a link to search for the business on Google Maps, rather than fake quote cards.
services_source: No verified, business-published itemized service menu with prices was found (no own site, no Booksy/Thumbtack/GlossGenius profile). The hireanypro.com lead-gen listing for this exact business offers a quote-request form for 'Standard cleaning, Deep cleaning, Move-in/move-out cleaning, Vacation rental turnover', which were used as the general service categories on the site (consistent with the task's own niche description). No specific prices are claimed anywhere; all CTAs route to 'free quote' by phone/text, per the adapted-variant rule for services without published pricing.

services.standard_recurring_cleaning: Weekly / biweekly / monthly recurring house cleaning
services.deep_cleaning: Top-to-bottom deep clean (kitchens, bathrooms, baseboards, etc.)
services.move_in_move_out_cleaning: Full clean before moving in or after moving out
services.vacation_rental_turnover: Turnover cleaning between guests for short-term rental hosts

evidence: Task brief gave a confirmed street address in Pembroke Pines, FL 33029.
Phone number +19546080904 (area code 954, Broward County, FL) matches exactly across the task brief, the Yelp listing, and MapQuest's structured data for the same business id.

MapQuest's LocalBusiness JSON-LD for this exact listing (mapquest.com/us/florida/sandys-spotless-cleaning-778745857) geocodes to lat 25.99816 / lng -80.38376 and postal code 33029, Broward County, FL, consistent with the given address.

photos.shortfall_reason: This business has no website, Instagram, or Facebook (its only photo source is its Yelp business-photo pool, surfaced indirectly via MapQuest's cached page for the same listing). Of the 10 Yelp-pool images recovered, only 2 are genuinely tied to this business (confirmed by MapQuest's own curated 'image' field for this listing, which includes exactly these 2 plus a generic stock soap-bubbles photo that was excluded): a real before/after bathroom sink cleaning photo and the business's own logo. The other 8 images in the same Yelp photo pool are unrelated community/trending photos (food dishes, a dog, a water park, a museum kitchen) that Yelp surfaces for thinly-reviewed/unclaimed listings, and were discarded per the visual curation rule. Per DESIGN.md guidance ('mejor menos secciones con buenas fotos que rellenar con malas'), the Gallery section was replaced with a single honest 'Real Results' before/after feature instead of a padded multi-tile grid.
photos.source: MapQuest page mapquest.com/us/florida/sandys-spotless-cleaning-778745857, which embeds this business's own Yelp-sourced photos (s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/.../o.jpg) in its schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD and page data. Downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent, verified real image files with `file`, resized/converted with ImageMagick.

files.description: Real before-and-after photo of a bathroom sink cleaned by Sandy's Spotless Cleaning (used as hero image, About image, and the Real Results feature image).
The business's own logo (woman-with-broom silhouette, 'Sandy's Spotless Cleaning', used as a small credibility avatar in the About section).

discarded: A plate of schnitzel/food (Yelp community photo, unrelated)
A splash pad / water park photo (unrelated)
A dog wearing a hat at the beach (unrelated)
A generic pink soap-bubbles stock photo (topically related to 'cleaning' but not a real photo of this business, excluded to avoid presenting stock art as real work)

template_base: output/outside-in-handyman-portcharlotte/index.html (itself derived from templates/light, Amani example), re-palette to a fresh teal/mint tone appropriate for a cleaning brand; the real Google Maps embed section from templates/light's 'ubicacion' pattern was added back in since this business has a confirmed street address.
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no published pricing (free quote via phone/text), no booking platform (CTA is call/text), real Google Maps embed (address confirmed), Gallery replaced by a single real before/after 'Results' feature instead of a padded photo grid (only 2 verified real photos exist), Reviews section shows the real 5.0/26 Google aggregate with a link to Google Maps instead of fabricated testimonial quotes (none could be verified).
palette: Custom light palette derived for this niche ('fresh/spotless' teal-mint), since no distinct brand color was evidenced beyond a black-and-white logo: bg #f6faf9, ink #1f332f, accent-deep #0f8b7f, accent-mid #4db6a8, accent-soft #d7f0ec.
gate_result: PASS on first attempt after fixing the multilingual localStorage key to be site-isolated (siteforge:lang:sandys-spotless-cleaning-pembrokepines) and removing navigator.language auto-detection, per scripts/gate.py's stricter isolation check.
notes: Status: staging (not deployed, per task instructions). Outreach channel is phone/SMS only (no public email). The 'established 2005 / 20 years in business' claim found in a Yelp search snippet for this listing was deliberately NOT used on the site or in outreach because it could not be independently verified beyond a single indirect search-engine snippet.
